bodyReadWithoutStatusCheck.text: This reads the body of [[response]] on a path where [[statusUnread]]. [[why]] [[repair]]

why.TypeScript: fetch does not throw on an HTTP error, so a 401 or 500 body is parsed here and used as data (an error object returned as a task list, a failure cached as a success).
why.Swift: URLSession does not throw on an HTTP error, so a 401 or 500 error page arrives here as data and is decoded, returned or kept as if the request had succeeded.

repair.TypeScript: Check `response.ok` before trusting the body, and throw or return the failure when it is false.
repair.Swift: Cast the response to HTTPURLResponse and check statusCode before trusting the body, and throw or return the failure when it is not a success.

why.TypeScript: fetch does not throw on an HTTP error, so a request that fails with a 400 or 500 runs on as if it succeeded.
why.Swift: Its status goes with it. URLSession does not throw on an HTTP error, so a request that fails with a 400 or 500 runs on as if it had succeeded.

repair.TypeScript: Keep the Response and check `response.ok`, and throw or return the failure when it is false.
repair.Swift: Keep the response, cast it to HTTPURLResponse and check statusCode, and throw or return the failure when it is not a success.
